description: This is the main application entry point for an iOS app using SwiftUI. It initializes core dependencies such as persistence, repository, network monitor, remote API, and synchronization engine, and sets up the main app scene with a notes list view.

classes.name: NotesAppApp
classes.description: Main application struct conforming to SwiftUI's App protocol. Sets up dependencies and the main scene.

classes.name: AppEnvironment
classes.description: Struct holding shared dependencies for the app, including persistence, repository, sync engine, and network monitor.

methods.name: init()
methods.description: Initializes the application environment, setting up core dependencies and the synchronization engine.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the main scene of the app, which displays the notes list view and initiates initial sync on appearance.
